model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance percentages of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern, stratified into three performance tiers as indicated in the caption. The horizontal axis represents the distinct model categories, although explicit textual labels for each individual category are omitted from the axis. The vertical axis displays the numerical values, labeled "Overall Performance (%)" in bold, rotated text, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 60 with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines appearing at regular intervals of 20. The chart consists of twelve individual, unsorted vertical bars, each filled with a different muted color and explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value positioned directly above the bar. Reading from left to right, the sequence features a grayish-green bar representing the highest value in the chart at 61.09, followed by a purple-gray bar (48.28), a blue-gray bar representing the lowest value (24.64), a dusty pink bar (60.72), a light blue-gray bar (48.83), a light brown bar (27.22), a light blue bar (54.83), a pale lilac bar (43.79), a pale peach bar (46.36), a light gray bar (44.09), a pale beige bar (40.87), and finally a pale pinkish-white bar (43.54). The bars are neither grouped nor stacked, and light vertical grid lines separate the unlabelled column sections in the background. The data does not follow a specific ascending or descending sort order, and apart from the precise numeric data labels atop each column, there is no additional visual emphasis such as bolding or highlighting applied to the bars.
